lots.title: Inspection & Maintenance of Indoor Gymnasium, Fitness & Sport Equipment and Outdoor Schools Play & Sport Equipment
lots.description: Single-lot ESPO Framework (reference 107_26) for inspection and maintenance services across indoor gymnasium equipment, indoor fitness and sport equipment, and outdoor schools play and sport equipment, including remedial works where required. Framework Period runs 24 June 2026 – 31 January 2028 with an option to extend up to 23 June 2030. The Tender Submission Document is the tenderer's response form that must be uploaded to the East Midlands eTendering (www.eastmidstenders.org) eProcurement Portal; closing date 12 noon, 15 May 2026.
requirements: Confirm compliance with all essential elements of the requirement and specification as outlined in Section 2 of the Invitation to Tender (Requirement/Specification).

Mandatory geographical coverage: supply Goods and/or Services to the nine defined regions of England (East Midlands, East of England, London, North East, North West, South East, South West, West Midlands, Yorkshire and Humber).
Optionally indicate ability to supply to Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland so the Framework may be made available to eligible public sector bodies in those nations.

Submit Method Statement responses to all 6 questions (5 quality-based + 1 Social Value); each quality method statement ≤ 700 words, Social Value method statement ≤ 500 words; text exceeding the limit will not be evaluated.
Complete and submit the Pricing Schedule (Appendix B) in full; failure to complete may result in tender rejection.
Complete the Social Value percentage table (for information only) covering Customer Contract Value bands from £0.01 up to £400,001+.
Allow for ESPO Framework Fees in submitted pricing; evaluation will be on the basis that such fees have been included.
State any confidential or commercially sensitive information on the Confidential Information Schedule with reasons and retention dates.
Sign the Tendering Declaration by a director, partner or senior authorised representative.
Tender offer must remain valid and open for acceptance for 120 days from the date of submission.
Lead Organisation and Supporting Organisations must be registered on the Central Digital Platform with accurate information.
On request, produce compliance certificates and sign a formal contract document if required.

evaluation_criteria.criterion: Q1 — Customer Engagement and Framework Management
evaluation_criteria.summary: Describe engagement with current/prospective customers, attraction/retention strategy, framework management (enquiry monitoring, resource/capacity management) and recording/supply of required Management Information identifying ESPO customers.

evidence_anchor.anchor_text: Q1 Customer Engagement and Framework Management ... (Weighting 3)

evaluation_criteria.summary: Describe process for making appointments for inspection, maintenance and remedial visits, arrival process on customer site, delivery of service requirements, and specific previous examples.
Provide an example completed inspection & maintenance report; outline key features, customer benefits and added value, and consistency mechanisms across staff members.

evaluation_criteria.criterion: Q4 — Services Following Completion of Work
evaluation_criteria.summary: Describe technical support, remedial works process, equipment decommissioning/reinstatement, enquiry response-time monitoring, and how lessons learned are captured for future Customer Contracts.

evidence_anchor.anchor_text: Q4 Services following completion of work ... (Weighting 4)

evaluation_criteria.summary: Describe how high safety and quality standards are maintained during inspections, maintenance and remedial work, including cost-minimisation, with previously evidenced examples.

evaluation_criteria.criterion: Q6 — Organisation's Current Approach to Social Value
evaluation_criteria.summary: Describe organisational understanding of Social Value, current/planned schemes or policies covering economic, social and environmental well-being, and measurement of scheme effectiveness.
